info.description:
Preview: the schema and base URL may change until Sunday, September 27, 2026, when the API moves to its permanent base URL and the official SDKs are released.

The ITMatrixHQ market analytics API. Every `/v2` response is a `{data, meta}` envelope; errors carry one code from a closed set; `meta.plane` reports provenance and `meta.caps` any entitlement limit that was applied.

Authenticate with `Authorization: Bearer itm_<key>`. The ITMatrixHQ apps send a first-party session token on the same header. An API key is refused with `403 not_entitled_tier` unless its account includes API access (web Pro includes API Explorer; the API plan includes API Pro), and with `403 attestation_required` unless the account has declared non-professional market-data use. Index symbols (SPX, NDX, VIX and others) and options on them are refused to API keys with `403 not_entitled_symbol`: index data is available in the ITMatrixHQ apps only.

Tags are scope groups, operationIds are `<scopeGroup>_<verbNoun>`, and `x-exposure` marks each operation `public`, `app-only` or `internal`. API keys may call `public` operations only.

Every listed contract of one underlying from a single capture, with quotes, open interest, implied volatility and greeks.

Read it live, or as of a past time with `at`. Every row is valued against the capture's one `spot`, and `partial: true` marks a capture known to be incomplete.

#### Units

- `oi` and `volume` are contracts; `theta` is dollars per day.
- `shares_per_contract` is the contract multiplier, 100 for standard contracts.

#### Freshness

A live chain is re-captured at most every 30 seconds per symbol, and may be up to 5 minutes old while a refresh runs. `captured_at` says when it was taken.

#### Empty results

A symbol with no listed options returns `rows: []`.

Dealer gamma exposure at every strike of one capture: the live profile, or a past one with `at=`.

`top=N` trims the rows but not the totals, which cover every strike left after expiry filtering. `flip_point` is the price where cumulative net GEX crosses zero, or `null` when it does not. Send `Accept: application/x-protobuf` for the protobuf body (`/v2/rest-protocol.proto`).

#### Units

- GEX values are dollars of dealer hedging per $1 move in the underlying, calls positive and puts negative.
- Each `*_shares` field is its dollar sibling in shares of the underlying per $1 move: the dollar value divided by `spot`, or by `prior_close_spot` when `spot` is `null`.
- A live per-strike read with no expiry filtered out takes `gex_shares`, `net_gex_shares` and `max_abs_gex_shares` from share gamma directly, so they can differ slightly from `gex` divided by `spot`.
